stage1.counterTypeCombination: SO 7 — Sacrifice (Social Seven counter-type, looks like Type 2)

stage2.ambiguityAxis: Hornevian: primary (Type 7) scores Assertive, alternative (Type 2) scores Compliant. Type 7 confirmed via Positive Outlook + Frustration; Type 2 confirmed via Compliant + Positive Outlook.

stage4.stressDescription: Under stress, the client recognized movement in both Type 1 territory (Seven's stress point — becoming more critical and perfectionistic) and Type 8 territory (Two's stress point — becoming more controlling and demanding). They identified more strongly with the Type 1 pattern (BOTH_MORE_A), consistent with Type 7's stress movement.
stage4.securityDescription: In ease, the client recognized both Type 5 territory (Seven's security — becoming more focused, still, and able to go deep) and Type 4 territory (Two's security — becoming more introspective and emotionally aware). They identified more strongly with Type 5 patterns (BOTH_MORE_A), consistent with Type 7's security movement.
stage4.habitDescription: The client's habit of mind description aligned more closely with Type 2 patterns (flattery, attending to others' needs and approval) than with Type 7 patterns (planning, reframing difficulty into future possibility). BOTH_MORE_B — slight lean toward Type 2's attention pattern, introducing a note of ambiguity.
